mapper.select: SELECT id,target_type,target_id,user_id,parent_id,reply_to_uid,reply_to_comment_id,status,audit_status,mentor_evidence,deleted_at FROM comment WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.target_id,COUNT(*) AS count FROM comment c WHERE c.target_type=#{type} AND c.status=1 AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.target_id IN #{id} AND (c.parent_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM comment p WHERE p.id=c.parent_id AND p.target_type=c.target_type AND p.target_id=c.target_id AND p.parent_id IS NULL AND ((p.status=1 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL) OR (c.community_thread=TRUE AND p.status IN(3,4) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM post s WHERE s.id=c.target_id AND s.post_type IN('NORMAL','MENTOR_QA')))))) GROUP BY c.target_id
SELECT FROM comment WHERE id=#{id} AND target_type=8 FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM comment WHERE target_type=8 AND target_id=#{articleId} AND status=1 AND deleted_at IS NULL AND parent_id=#{parentId}AND parent_id IS NULL AND (created_at > #{afterTime} OR (created_at=#{afterTime} AND id > #{afterId})) ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT #{size}
mapper.update: UPDATE comment SET status=3,deleted_at=#{now},updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND target_type=8 AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE target_type=8 AND parent_id=#{id} AND status=1 AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE comment SET status = 1, deleted_at = NULL WHERE id = #{commentId} AND status = 4 AND audit_status = 1 AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
UPDATE comment SET status = 1, audit_status = 1, deleted_at = NULL WHERE id = #{commentId} AND status IN (0, 2) AND audit_status IN (0, 2)
UPDATE comment SET status = 2, audit_status = 2, deleted_at = COALESCE(deleted_at, NOW()) WHERE id = #{commentId} AND status IN (0, 2) AND audit_status IN (0, 2)
